# Backend indexing logic and unification (2026-02-02 04:46Z)

_**User**_

do this task step by step "What to change so “indexing” works
When you want “full index” (e.g. /index full or “Analyze Folder”):
Keep creating the local manifest if you need it for UX, but also call the backend POST /index with the current workspace root_path and mode: "full".
Wait until the backend is done (e.g. poll GET /health until indexing === false), then show “Indexing complete.” / report.
When you want “index exists” for gating (e.g. before /ask):
Either:
Check the backend (e.g. call GET /health or a small “index status” endpoint that uses the same repo_id / path as the backend), or
Check for the manifest in the same place the backend uses: e.g. RAG_INDEX_DIR or %USERPROFILE%\.offline_rag_index + repoId + manifest.json, using the same normalizeRootPath + repo_id as the backend.
Optional: Unify so there is a single notion of “index”: the one the backend creates under .offline_rag_index (or RAG_INDEX_DIR), and the extension only triggers it (POST /index) and checks it (same path or backend API).
That’s the logic behind indexing and why your current extension logic doesn’t produce a real index or responses until POST /index is called (e.g. manually or after you add that call in the extension)."
